stateInput.text: Plan the quarterly reliability initiative for the payments platform. We need to reduce p99 latency on the checkout path from 900ms to under 400ms, eliminate the recurring deadlock in the ledger writer, and cut flaky integration tests from 6% to under 1%. Survey the current architecture, identify the ten highest-leverage interventions, and sequence them into three milestones with owners, dependencies, and measurable exit criteria. Flag anything that requires a breaking change to the public API, and propose a deprecation timeline for the legacy sync client. Include a rollback plan per milestone and a summary of the risks with mitigations.
